purpose: Determine whether train-fitted task-error partitions create useful frozen-trunk residual experts before attempting another blind router.

authorization_source.guardrail: the prior result remains frozen; this protocol cannot retroactively rescue or relabel it

gene_firewall.construction: one deterministic global partition of the checkpoint gene order
gene_firewall.axis_forward_mask: mask the complete probe and score panels

candidate_family.multiplicity_guardrail: only the named primary may directly justify a separately frozen confirmation; a secondary winner requires a new confirmation and cannot open the sealed test

axis_discovery.head_gradient: exact per-sample gradient of probe MSE with respect to a zero-initialized shared linear residual head
axis_discovery.train_only_transform: per-feature standardization, PCA-32, row L2 normalization
axis_discovery.clustering: three train-only KMeans initializations followed by exact capacity-balanced assignment; choose the AMI medoid
axis_discovery.calibration_projection: nearest frozen train centroid without calibration refitting

expert_training.architecture: frozen pooled trunk plus independent dimension-64 residual expert adapters
expert_training.loss: individual assigned-expert masked reconstruction MSE; never blended-output MSE
expert_training.checkpoint_policy: predetermined final update; no calibration checkpoint selection
expert_training.packed_execution: all seven independent banks share frozen trunk activations and one deterministic natural sample schedule; each bank has independent parameters, optimizer, scheduler, and stop update
expert_training.sampling_metadata: organ and study do not affect the training schedule; they are used only for split integrity and balanced evaluation

evaluation.crossfit_fixed_mixture: five folds kept intact by connected study and balanced by organ
comparisons_per_candidate: fixed candidate dispatch versus pooled trunk
fixed candidate dispatch versus matched random partition at the same K
hard per-sample oracle versus study-cross-fitted fixed mixture
fixed candidate dispatch versus newly hard-trained organ-K5 anchor on the exact same score genes

decision.primary_replacement_candidate: primary clears all core gates and beats organ-K5 by at least 3%; freeze a separate confirmation protocol before any test access
decision.primary_augmentation_candidate: primary clears pooled, random, complementarity, utilization, stability, and confound gates but does not beat organ; retain organ and test only an organ-to-state extension later
decision.secondary_candidate: a secondary clears the gates; freeze and run a new confirmation because this family was exploratory
decision.technical_partition: performance or utilization appears only in a study-dominated partition; stop biological interpretation and repair cohort/QC
decision.no_discrete_headroom: no candidate clears the core gates; stop discrete label-free MoE for the current random-gene reconstruction objective
decision.test_policy: this pilot never automatically authorizes or accesses the sealed Stage 1 test
